svg.title: Plant to central: every container, port and data store
svg.desc: Each shop's 100 devices talk over RJ45 Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth LE or serial to one plant-wide network per medium; a unified device interface normalises their frames and forwards them to five shop gateways, which buffer in SQLite and produce to plant Kafka; MirrorMaker 2 copies the plant topics over the WAN into central Kafka; two store-writer consumers insert into PostgreSQL under a unique (machine_id, seq) key; a control-room API and dashboard watch every stage; and a ledger lists who writes and reads each store, when and how.
svg.text: PLANT 1 · ON-SITE · DOCKER NETWORK plant · DEMO: DEVICES, FIELD NETWORKS AND DEVICE INTERFACE ARE SIMULATED INSIDE EACH GATEWAY
